title: FizzBuzz
hints: Loop from 1 to n and push one string into a result array per number. The `%` operator tells you if a number divides evenly.
Check "divisible by both 3 and 5" (i.e. by 15) **first** — otherwise the 3 check will grab it. Use `String(i)` for the plain numbers.
for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { if (i % 15 === 0) out.push("FizzBuzz"); else if (i % 3 === 0) out.push("Fizz"); else if (i % 5 === 0) out.push("Buzz"); else out.push(String(i)); }
